MCPHub has Path Traversal via Malicious MCPB Manifest Name

Severity: CVSS_V4: CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:L/UI:N/VC:N/VI:H/VA:H/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N

Affected:

**MCPB File Upload Handler** extracts a ZIP file and reads `manifest.json` from it. The `name` field in the manifest is directly concatenated into a file path (line 107) without any sanitization or path traversal character validation. An attacker can craft a malicious MCPB file where `manifest.name` is set to something like `../../../etc/malicious`, causing the file to be extracted to an arbitrary location on the file system.
